pattern: proxy finish LIGHT (proxy_finish.py stage_light + proxy_finish_light.py): the frozen Pixal3D sheet proxy kept as generated (geometry + texture), made watertight, decimated, baked, optionally reposed with bones

config.fit_side_length_why: v2b proxy (sha c36d9494): side length / front height 0.823 vs the sheet's 0.845 (-2.5 %, inside the 5 % gate): no fit, kept as generated
config.refloor_why: v2b: no refloor, no rescale (brief V2b: no forced rescale to the 3/4 front height). sheet_proxy's floor (the lowest vertex) is the TALONS: -x talon (-0.51, -0.46, 0.000), +x talon (0.57, -0.44, 0.000): both feet on z 0; the tail lies on the floor behind (never below z 0). Height 6.78 u (sheet front 6.69 / back 6.49 / side 7.21)
config.midline_x_why: v2b: none. The regenerated proxy is centred: body mid-x per 0.4 u z band -0.002..+0.009; the vertex mirror p99 is lowest at plane x 0 (0.040 u) vs +-0.02 (0.052)

light.ao_why: AO baked on the watertight low itself: the layered-feather soup has inner shells that black-hole AO rays (ember_rex / vulture_creature lesson)
light.ao_distance_why: about one feather-blade width: real crevices darken, the broad feather mass does not (batch lesson: AO darkens the basecolor below the sheet)
light.ao_fill_below_why: AO texels < 0.04 (bake origins between fused feather blades) refilled from their valid neighbours
light.bake_drop_interior_why: proxy faces with solid on both sides (inner shells under the layered feathers) left out of the bake source so the cage stays tight
light.uv_island_margin_why: the feather low unwraps into thousands of islands; margin 0.001 keeps the atlas texel coverage up (vulture_creature lesson)

dense.why: the head: flame crest (top z 6.78, spike x +-0.02), hooked beak (front y -2.79), both eyes (proxy sha c36d9494; stage-1 frame = the proxy frame); vg_weight 0.3 so the face / eye boxes below sit denser
the face: beak (y -2.79..-2.44, z 4.93..5.5), gape and the eye band held denser
the -x eye (painted almond, centre (-0.185, -2.32, 5.39), +-0.072 u): held dense so rim / iris / pupil land on separate faces
the +x eye (the mirror of the -x box)

light.dense_why: v2b: boxes re-measured on the regenerated proxy (sha c36d9494)

recolour3d.name: neck_cream
recolour3d.why: the sheet's cream neck (chip 246,214,182; v1 target 232,176,134 kept): on the v2b proxy (sha c36d9494) the front of the neck reads MAUVE (throat texels L* 26..31, a* 33..39, b* 14..22), not cream. Region = spheres along the FRONT of the neck on the midline (the midline slab's front edge y -2.09 at z 4.6, -2.23 at 4.3, -2.42 at 4.0, -2.37 at 3.7), radius 0.24..0.15 tapering into the sheet's chest V at z ~3.5 (sheet front view: the cream runs from the throat down to the chest V, px y 450 -> z 3.36); select = the non-fire, non-outline texels (L* 14..42, a* 18..56, b* 4..30) -> 232,176,134, shading kept (gamma 0.8, clip 0.6..1.15). v2b run 0 (a neck BOX z 3.3..5.12, mauve-only select) left a blotchy throat and a square cream band on the chest plate. Run first: the fire / body specs never see it (cream b* 29 < the fire b* floors 38..40; L* 76 > the body L* ceiling 46)

recolour3d.name: fire_core
recolour3d.why: UNIT V2 NOTE 2 (artist: the flames do not contrast enough with the body): the HOT CORES = the brightest proxy flame texels (L* >= 74: median 244,166,57 / 248,199,84, 1.3 % of the surface, at the flame tips) to PALE YELLOW 255,236,165 (L* 93), near flat (gamma 0.3). Hottest first so no fire texel is recoloured twice

recolour3d.name: fire_hot
recolour3d.why: the yellow band (proxy L* 61..74: median 236,128,38, 2.5 %) to the sheet's YELLOW 255,198,85 (chip 253,201,100, a touch more saturated), gamma 0.5

recolour3d.name: fire_base
recolour3d.why: the orange flame base (proxy L* 44..61 with b* >= 38: median 221,88,22 / 193,50,18, ~10 %) to the sheet's ORANGE pushed brighter + more saturated 255,128,42 (chip 253,124,67: C* 70 -> 78), gamma 0.7 / clip 0.8..1.3 so its bright end runs on toward the yellow band (255,166,55) and its dark end stays deep orange (204,102,34): the proxy's own tip-ward gradient kept

recolour3d.name: collar_crest_fire
recolour3d.why: artist image ember_rex_2-v1-flame-collar-annotation.png (the flame COLLAR band across the neck base / shoulders) + the flame CREST: inside those regions the red-orange texels just below the fire floor (L* 32..44, b* >= 28) become flame too (deep flame orange 240,96,36), so the collar / crest read as one fire band. Collar = 3 boxes rising from the front of the neck base (y -2.5, z 3.8..4.45) to the back of the neck (y -0.3, z 4.1..4.9) (proxy side render: the orange collar patch y -1.4..-2.45, z 3.95..4.4 and the neck-back flame panels y -0.4..-1.4, z 4.3..4.85); crest = z >= 5.6 behind the beak (+ the back-crest panels z 5.15..5.6, y -1.7..-0.5)

recolour3d.name: body_muted
recolour3d.why: UNIT V2 NOTE 2: the BODY (every non-fire texel L* 6..46: proxy median 95,9,6, a pure saturated red with no green / blue; bright crimson 157,28,17) to a DARKER, MUTED red: target 84,28,30 at the median (between the sheet chips 68,38,42 and 120,35,40; run 1 at 100,34,38 rendered a light dusty mauve under the survey light), gamma 0.6 / clip 0.62..1.4 so the darkest land near 52,17,19 and the brightest near 118,39,42 (well below v1's 235,66,52 bright red). The black feather outlines (L* < 6) stay as generated; fire texels (now L* >= 54) are outside the select; no exclude (the beak's red base and the face around the eyes go muted too; the beak's yellow is above the select)

recolour3d.name: eye_mx_rim
recolour3d.why: UNIT V2 NOTE 2 (1) (artist: cant see the eye): a crisp eye on each side of the head at the sheet's position (sheet side view eye px (652, 219): 0.35 u behind and 0.47 u above the beak tip, just above + behind the gape corner (641, 238); on the proxy: beak tip y -2.68 z 4.95, gape y -2.43 z 5.17 -> eye centre y -2.32, z 5.39, under the yellow brow streak as on the sheet). ONE design for both eyes (mirrored: the same (y, z) design, each sphere centre projected onto that side's outermost head surface; head mirror p99 0.037 u): a tilted almond (axis rising 12 deg toward the back, as the sheet's head panel), dark rim 34,16,14: half-length 0.072, half-height 0.044 (the sheet side-view eye with its dark surround ~0.09 x 0.06 u; held ~1.2x so it reads at game scale); spheres along the axis, radius b(1 - (s/a)^2), feather 0.003 (mx eye)

recolour3d.name: eye_mx_iris
recolour3d.why: the iris almond (half-length 0.056, half-height 0.031 inside the 0.013..0.016 rim): intense yellow-orange 255,186,58 (brief ~255,190,60; sheet side-view eye px mean 252,191,103), flat (mx eye)

recolour3d.name: eye_mx_core
recolour3d.why: the iris' hot centre around the pupil (r 0.022): 255,214,104, so the iris reads bright yellow inside a deeper orange edge (sheet head panel) (mx eye)

recolour3d.name: eye_mx_pupil
recolour3d.why: the dark round pupil (r 0.015, the sheet head panel's round pupil): 26,10,8 (mx eye)

ONE design for both eyes (mirrored: the same (y, z) design, each sphere centre projected onto that side's outermost head surface; head mirror p99 0.037 u): a tilted almond (axis rising 12 deg toward the back, as the sheet's head panel), dark rim 34,16,14: half-length 0.072, half-height 0.044 (the sheet side-view eye with its dark surround ~0.09 x 0.06 u; held ~1.2x so it reads at game scale); spheres along the axis, radius b(1 - (s/a)^2), feather 0.003 (px eye)

recolour3d.name: eye_px_iris
recolour3d.why: the iris almond (half-length 0.056, half-height 0.031 inside the 0.013..0.016 rim): intense yellow-orange 255,186,58 (brief ~255,190,60; sheet side-view eye px mean 252,191,103), flat (px eye)

recolour3d.name: eye_px_core
recolour3d.why: the iris' hot centre around the pupil (r 0.022): 255,214,104, so the iris reads bright yellow inside a deeper orange edge (sheet head panel) (px eye)

recolour3d.why: the dark round pupil (r 0.015, the sheet head panel's round pupil): 26,10,8 (px eye)

light.recolour3d_why: v2b (UNIT V2 NOTE 2): texture-only, geometry untouched; order = neck cream -> fire (hottest first) -> collar / crest flame -> muted body -> the two eyes (last, so nothing repaints them)

glow3d.name: leg_cracks
glow3d.why: the sheet's glowing leg cracks ('glowing, flame-lit texture'): feet + tarsus faces whose baked albedo is the crack orange / yellow (L* >= 58, b* >= 40) -> leg_cracks

glow3d.name: flame_core
glow3d.why: UNIT V2 NOTE 2 (2) hot cores: faces whose baked albedo is the pale-yellow core (L* >= 87) -> flame_core (emission 255,232,160 x 0.85, the brightest)

glow3d.name: flame_tips
glow3d.why: the yellow flame tips (baked L* >= 76, b* >= 45) -> flame_tips (emission 255,190,80 x 0.55; v1 0.35)

glow3d.name: flame_base
glow3d.why: the orange flame body (baked L* >= 56, b* >= 45: the recoloured orange 255,128,42 and the collar / crest flame 240,96,36) -> flame_base (emission 253,124,50 x 0.3); the muted body (L* <= ~36) and the cream neck (b* ~29) stay UNLIT. Run 1 at base 0.6 / tips 0.9 / cores 1.0 (+ an eye glow x 0.45) flattened the glow faces into uniform emissive shards (the glow is per face, one emission colour each) and lit a triangle across the eye: lowered to 0.3 / 0.55 / 0.85 so the baked orange -> yellow gradient reads through, eye glow dropped (optional in the brief)

rig.spine_why: v2b proxy frame, on the midline x 0 (body mid-x per z band within +-0.01): hips inside the feather mass above the thighs (z 2.2), chest under the collar, neck root at the neck base (midline slab y -2.42..-0.44 at z 4.0), head joint at the skull (y -1.95, z 5.2: midline slab mid y -1.96 at z 4.9..5.5), tip toward the beak (y -2.55, z 5.45)

chains.name: wing
chains.why: the hanging feather wings: shoulder (x 0.6, z 3.8) down the outer feather mass (|x| > 0.8: y median -1.32 at z 3.6, -0.38 at z 2.8, +0.48 at z 2.0, +0.73 at z 1.6) to the tips; 3 bones per side, mirrored

chains.name: leg
chains.why: hip (inside the thigh feathers), knee (tarsus top, x 0.36 y -0.3 at z 1.4..1.6), ankle (x 0.42, z 0.45), foot to the front talons (lowest +x talon 0.57, -0.44, 0.0; toes to y -0.9); +x chain mirrored to -x (the proxy legs are a mirror pair)

chains.name: tail
chains.why: brief V2b: a 4-bone TAIL CHAIN (tail.0..tail.3) resting CENTRED on the midline x 0 (the regenerated tail is centred: x -1.06..1.05 at y 2.1), along the trailing feather mass (median z 2.15 at y 0.9, 1.8 at y 1.5, 1.31 at y 2.1, 1.0 at y 2.4); poses to either side later

config.repose_why: v2b: NO repose. The regenerated proxy is already mirror-symmetric (vertex mirror p99 about x 0: head z > 4.8 0.037 u, body 0.040 u, whole 0.040 u; v1 1.02 u): head straight, crest centred, legs paired, tail centred behind. Nothing to undo with bones; the tail chain rests centred

clips.why: PLACEHOLDER (movement + height are the open artist questions): idle = breathe 1.5 deg + the kit's wing / tail sway; walk = a short raptor stalk-step (leg_swing 8: the kit's foot bend dips the toes below the floor at larger swings; ember_rex values)

config.focus_why: brief V2b close-ups: head front + side (eyes), collar, a wing, tail. The camera angles live in focus_closeup_views (not focus.views): the light build's focus shift reads every focus entry as a box (proxy_finish_light.py run_light line 1367, KeyError on a views dict; kit gap reported); the angled close-ups are rendered after the run with the render script's own focus views
config._doc: v2b LIGHT finish of the REGENERATED Pixal3D proxy (symmetric views, seed 56, sha c36d9494): no side-length fit, no refloor / rescale / midline shift, no cuts, no repose (mirror p99 0.037 head / 0.040 body). UNIT V2 NOTE 2: fire brighter + more saturated (orange -> yellow -> pale-yellow cores) with stronger glow (3 flame regions), body darker muted red and unlit, crisp yellow-orange eyes on both sides; the cream neck kept from v1. Points: the proxy frame (= the stage-1 frame), sheet units.

recolour3d.name: collar_crest_fire
recolour3d.why: artist image ember_rex_2-v1-flame-collar-annotation.png (the flame COLLAR band across the neck base / shoulders) + the flame CREST: inside those regions the red-orange texels just below the fire floor (L* 32..44, b* >= 28) become flame too (deep flame orange 240,96,36), so the collar / crest read as one fire band. Collar = 3 boxes rising from the front of the neck base (y -2.5, z 3.8..4.45) to the back of the neck (y -0.3, z 4.1..4.9) (proxy side render: the orange collar patch y -1.4..-2.45, z 3.95..4.4 and the neck-back flame panels y -0.4..-1.4, z 4.3..4.85); crest = z >= 5.6 behind the beak (+ the back-crest panels z 5.15..5.6, y -1.7..-0.5)

recolour3d.name: body_muted
recolour3d.why: UNIT V2 NOTE 2: the BODY (every non-fire texel L* 6..46: proxy median 95,9,6, a pure saturated red with no green / blue; bright crimson 157,28,17) to a DARKER, MUTED red: target 84,28,30 at the median (between the sheet chips 68,38,42 and 120,35,40; run 1 at 100,34,38 rendered a light dusty mauve under the survey light), gamma 0.6 / clip 0.62..1.4 so the darkest land near 52,17,19 and the brightest near 118,39,42 (well below v1's 235,66,52 bright red). The black feather outlines (L* < 6) stay as generated; fire texels (now L* >= 54) are outside the select; no exclude (the beak's red base and the face around the eyes go muted too; the beak's yellow is above the select)

high.rule: marching tets of the whole remesh grid (no mirror)

low.method: collapse decimation: uniform to 300000, then 18000 with the dense boxes calibrated

dense.rule: dense boxes weighted 0.02 (vs 1) in the collapse decimation; the factor bisected until the boxes hold density x the rest's triangles per area

ao_fill.rule: AO < below = a bake origin inside the proxy soup: refilled from the covered valid 3x3 neighbours ring by ring (opt-in light.ao_fill_below)

bake.source: the proxy mesh itself (not the remesh)

rows.why: the sheet's glowing leg cracks ('glowing, flame-lit texture'): feet + tarsus faces whose baked albedo is the crack orange / yellow (L* >= 58, b* >= 40) -> leg_cracks
UNIT V2 NOTE 2 (2) hot cores: faces whose baked albedo is the pale-yellow core (L* >= 87) -> flame_core (emission 255,232,160 x 0.85, the brightest)
the yellow flame tips (baked L* >= 76, b* >= 45) -> flame_tips (emission 255,190,80 x 0.55; v1 0.35)

the orange flame body (baked L* >= 56, b* >= 45: the recoloured orange 255,128,42 and the collar / crest flame 240,96,36) -> flame_base (emission 253,124,50 x 0.3); the muted body (L* <= ~36) and the cream neck (b* ~29) stay UNLIT. Run 1 at base 0.6 / tips 0.9 / cores 1.0 (+ an eye glow x 0.45) flattened the glow faces into uniform emissive shards (the glow is per face, one emission colour each) and lit a triangle across the eye: lowered to 0.3 / 0.55 / 0.85 so the baked orange -> yellow gradient reads through, eye glow dropped (optional in the brief)

glow3d.rule: faces -> glow palette regions (emission -> Glow -> Emission Color); rgb white keeps the baked albedo

mirror.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)

floor.rule: stage 1 floored the FEET at z 0; the centring puts the lowest point at 0

facing.rule: shell centroid -> the front-most midline point of the shell (proxy finish default)

mirror.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)
